note: Read 2026-10-30. Mayotte is an overseas department of France (the Constitution, art. 72-3), governed by art. 73, under which France's laws and regulations apply as of right, the Highway Code's licence among them: its licence is France's, as Guadeloupe's is. The prefecture's page on the driving licence opens the national guide to procedures (procedure N530), which loads only with scripts and wasn't read.

sources.title: Conseil constitutionnel, Texte intégral de la Constitution du 4 octobre 1958 en vigueur, articles 72-3 and 73
sources.said: La Guadeloupe, la Guyane, la Martinique, La Réunion, Mayotte ... Dans les départements et les régions d'outre-mer, les lois et règlements sont applicables de plein droit.
